gist: Product Notes is a weekly newsletter from notes@productnotes.example, received by Nia in October 2026. Nine issues arrived between 4 and 26 October [n1095, n1106, n1112, n1148, n1160, n1167, n1203, n1210, n1217], with titles such as 'the autumn issue', 'tools and tips' and 'our favourite links'. The current state is simply that the latest issue came on 26 October [n1217]. The body text is the same boilerplate in every issue (picks, links, reader letter, unsubscribe note), so there is no personal content and no open loops or upcoming dates. Nothing suspicious found; it is routine newsletter traffic.
